note: Fit-audit repaint 2026-10-21 (hook standard v2): each figure acts out its word's new hook (sound cue + meaning). The white pillar splits the room: feminine words left, masculine words and adjectives right. One box per item.

items.label: la purée
items.scene: A grey stingray (RAY) turns up its nose, 'PEW!' (pew-RAY), beside a bowl of MASHED POTATO.

items.label: la moutarde
items.scene: A cow says 'MOO' over a TART (moo-TAHRD) smeared thickly with yellow MUSTARD.

items.label: la vanille
items.scene: Like English 'vanilla' but said vah-NEEY (no final 'a'): a girl sniffs a dark VANILLA pod beside a scoop of ice cream.

items.label: la cuisson
items.scene: A quizmaster rabbit rings a buzzer, 'QUIZ ON!' (kwee-SOHN), while timing the COOKING of a roast with an egg timer.

items.label: la salsa
items.scene: Same as English 'salsa' (stress at the end, sahl-SAH): two tomatoes dance a twirl beside a bowl of chunky SALSA.

items.label: la bouillabaisse
items.scene: Same as English 'bouillabaisse' (said boo-yah-BEHS): a fisherwoman stirs a big pot of FISH STEW with a crab peeping over the rim.

items.label: la gastronomie
items.scene: Same as English 'gastronomy' (said gahs-troh-noh-MEE): an old chef with a medal carries a tall tower of FINE FRENCH DISHES.

items.label: le préparatif
items.scene: Like English 'preparations' but said pray-pah-rah-TEEF: a busy grandpa ticks off a long list of PARTY PREPARATIONS, candles and plates.

items.label: le barbecue
items.scene: Same as English 'barbecue' (said bahr-buh-KYOO): a grandma in a striped apron flips sausages on a smoking BARBECUE.

items.label: l'ingrédient
items.scene: Same as English 'ingredient' (said an-gray-DYAHN): a fox lines up eggs, flour and butter, the INGREDIENTS for a cake.

items.label: gastronomique
items.scene: Same as English 'gastronomic', ending MEEK: a MEEK little mouse proudly presents a tiny GOURMET plate under a silver dome.
